image_description: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a bicycle wheel hub featuring a ventilated disc brake rotor. The rotor has a complex, spider-like internal structure with cutouts for weight reduction and cooling. It is mounted to the axle with visible bolts. In the background, out-of-focus bicycle spokes, a fork leg with a 'Rock Shox' sticker, and a cycling shoe are visible. There is text in the bottom corners indicating date and photographer signature.
